title: CFA® Level II Complete Course
shortDescription: Asset valuation in depth: item-set practice for equity, fixed income, derivatives, FSA and quantitative methods.
description: Level II is about applying valuation tools to realistic vignettes. This course works through every topic area with an emphasis on item-set reasoning, multi-step calculations and the accounting adjustments analysts make in practice.
whoFor: Candidates who have passed CFA® Level I
Analysts who want deeper valuation and modelling skills
outcomes: Value equities with DDM, FCFE/FCFF and residual income models
Analyse intercorporate investments, pensions and multinational operations
Value bonds with embedded options and credit risk using binomial trees
Price and value forwards, futures, swaps and options
Solve vignette-style item sets under time pressure

faq.q: Is the full course available now?
faq.a: The course structure is published. Lessons are released progressively; enrolled students get every lesson as soon as it is live.
